artifact_reasoning: Significant structural artifacts are present in the human subjects. The background text is illegible gibberish. While the stage structure itself is solid, the artifacts in the primary content (the performers) lower the overall quality. The severity is moderate (not catastrophic) because the main subject (the stage) remains structurally sound.
